note: MYTHOS MCP permission matrix — the DECLARED policy. subject × capability → decision, with a tool-class table that maps server.tool names onto capabilities. Enforcement points already exist and stay where they are (the OTH MCP tool set exposes no write; the executor policy engine records approvals; ContextForge authenticates clients). lib/mcp-policy.js evaluates this matrix for the executor's governed invoke and for the registry check, which flags any exposed tool the matrix would deny. A capability's decision is a CEILING a subject grant can only narrow; `destructive` is DENY by hard floor; a tool no rule names is unclassified and therefore denied.

decisions.CONTROLLED: executable only with a recorded, granted approval (executor policy engine: requestApproval -> decideApproval), consumed once
decisions.RESTRICTED: never available to an agent subject; a human subject may hold it, and only as CONTROLLED

mythos.read.description: read MYTHOS state through oth-mcp (knowledge, portfolio, capabilities, execution truth, budget, health)

github.read.description: read repositories, issues, pull requests, workflow runs, code scanning

github.issue.description: create or comment on issues and labels

github.write.description: push files, create branches, repositories, gists

github.pull_request.description: open, update or review a pull request

github.actions.description: run, re-run or cancel a workflow

github.merge.description: merge a pull request — protected paths remain governed by the delivery relay regardless

vault.read.description: return a credential VALUE to a subject (MYTHOS_VAULT_ARCHITECTURE §6: the narrow, justified exception)

infrastructure.description: host, container, DNS, firewall or service changes

destructive.description: delete a repository, a branch, a run log, a workflow — irreversible on a third party

tool_classes.note: first, so no later glob can reclassify a delete

executor.description: mythos-ai-executor governed invoke (bearer holder on 127.0.0.1:8130) — the only subject that executes on MYTHOS' behalf

othmode.description: the OTHMODE read model — computes the `authorized` flag it publishes; it never executes

claude.description: Claude as a remote gateway client (credential not yet issued — owner decision #2)

chatgpt.description: ChatGPT as a remote gateway client (credential not yet issued — owner decision #2)

owner.description: the human owner, acting through an authenticated session
